items.name: LaSonya Adams
items.bio: LaSonya Adams founded Ty's Future Stars Foundation in 2021 to honor her son, Tykeem “Ty” D'Majh Franklin. She brings more than 20 years of healthcare leadership experience to the foundation's work in scholarships, mentorship, athletics, leadership development, and community outreach.

photo.alt: LaSonya Adams, Founder and President of Ty's Future Stars Foundation.
